# Image fixtures

- `pixel.webp`: hand-made, a valid 1×1 lossless WebP (34 bytes), served as every image body.
- `en/swshp-SWSH032.json`: recorded on 2026-10-12 from `https://api.tcgdex.net/v2/en/cards/swshp-SWSH032`, trimmed to `id` and `image`.
- `en/svp-085.no-image.json`: recorded on 2026-10-12 from `https://api.tcgdex.net/v2/en/cards/svp-085`, which has no `image`; trimmed to `id`.
